response.answer: David Hulme is a leading researcher on microfinance and poverty alleviation in Ghana, known for his work on financial sustainability and rural development. He is Executive Director of the Global Development Institute at the University of Manchester. He has been awarded an OBE for services to research and international development.

results.title: David Hulme - Research Explorer - The University of Manchester
results.content: David Hulme is Professor of Development Studies at the University of Manchester where he is Executive Director of the Global Development Institute and CEO of the Effective States and Inclusive Development Research Centre. * Bangladesh Institute of Development Studies - Visiting Professor and Joint Director Programme for Research on  Chronic Poverty in Bangladesh, April 2002 - April 2006. * Special Issue: Chronic Poverty and Social Protection, European Journal of Development Research, 17(1) (with A Barrientos), 2005. * 2010-2013 - ESRC/DFID Research on International Development Grant: Principal investigator for ‘Community and institutional responses to the challenges facing poor urban people in an era of climate change in Bangladesh’ (with S Guy and M Roy). * UK Director of PRCPB, a collaborative research programme operated by IDPM and the Bangladesh Institute of Development Studies. * **Institute of Development Studies, University of Sussex (2006-2009)** - Member of Advisory Council to id21 (the organisation responsible for the dissemination of UK research on International Development in the UK, Europe and globally).
